en.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel. And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
en.riddle: Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, and behold the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
en.speaker: The LORD

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל-מֹשֶׁה עֲלֵה אֶל-הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה; וּרְאֵה, אֶת-הָאָרֶץ, אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי, לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְרָאִיתָה אֹתָהּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל-עַמֶּיךָ גַּם-אָתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר נֶאֱסַף אַהֲרֹן אָחִֽיךָ
he.riddle: עֲלֵה אֶל-הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה; וּרְאֵה, אֶת-הָאָרֶץ, אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי, לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי

en.quote: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying, Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, Set a man over the congregation, Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
en.riddle: Set a man over the congregation
en.speaker: Moses

he.quote: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל-יְהוָה לֵאמֹֽר יִפְקֹד יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכָל-בָּשָׂר אִישׁ, עַל-הָעֵדָה אֲשֶׁר-יֵצֵא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יָבֹא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יוֹצִיאֵם וַאֲשֶׁר יְבִיאֵם וְלֹא תִהְיֶה עֲדַת יְהוָה כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין-לָהֶם רֹעֶֽה
he.speaker: מֹשֶׁה

en.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him; And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight. And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient. And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
en.riddle: Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is spirit, and lay thy hand upon him
en.speaker: The LORD

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל-מֹשֶׁה קַח-לְךָ אֶת-יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן-נוּן--אִישׁ, אֲשֶׁר-רוּחַ בּוֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ אֶת-יָדְךָ עָלָֽיו וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כָּל-הָעֵדָה וְצִוִּיתָה אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם וְנָתַתָּה מֵהֽוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כָּל-עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמֹד וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַל-פִּיו יֵצְאוּ וְעַל-פִּיו יָבֹאוּ הוּא וְכָל-בְּנֵי-יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתּוֹ וְכָל-הָעֵדָֽה
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
